metadata.name: Research implementation based on publicly documented criteria from the MSCI Islamic Index Series methodology
metadata.scope: Independent research implementation by Suhail of the business-activity and total-assets financial-ratio screens in the MSCI Islamic Index Series methodology (December 2025), adapted to US SEC filings. Not affiliated with, endorsed by or licensed by MSCI, and not an MSCI index, rating or statement of compliance. Suhail is a stock screen, not an index, so the thresholds for existing index constituents are used. Not applied: index membership, entry and exit buffers, the three-consecutive-review rule and four-period average ratios (§2.2.1); index review timing and data dates (§3.1); country exceptions for Sharia-compliant debt and instruments (§2.2); the Islamic financial institution exemption (Appendix 3); the GICS code list (Appendix 4); treating insufficient information as non-compliant (Suhail reports unknown instead); the M-Series; dividend purification (§2.3).
metadata.notes: D-172. Copyrighted source: only the link, edition, SHA-256 and Suhail's paraphrase with section locators are stored; no source text or file is stored or served. The source URL is MSCI's 'latest' link and may later resolve to a newer edition; the recorded hash identifies the December 2025 file. Reviewer questions are listed in reviewer_questions.

version.changelog: Initial draft of an independent research implementation of the December 2025 edition. Unpublished, unapproved and not production-enabled.
version.notes: D-172 draft. Existing-constituent Financial Ratio Thresholds (§2.2.1), not the stricter entry buffers.

purification_treatment.label: Dividend purification
purification_treatment.note: Suhail does not calculate a dividend adjustment factor.

criteria.label: Directly active in an excluded activity
criteria.definition: Companies directly active in an excluded activity are excluded. Suhail tests whether the classified primary activity is in an excluded category.
criteria.formula_text: Fail if the classified primary activity is in the excluded list; unclassified is unknown.
criteria.treatment_rules: Suhail interpretation of 'directly active' as the classified primary activity. Wider readings (any direct involvement) are a reviewer question. Music, hotels and cinema categories come only from analyst classification, never from the shared SIC table (D-173). Unclassified never passes.
criteria.edge_cases: Missing segments or an unclassified or tied primary activity requires review.
criteria.notes: conventional_media is not on the list: MSCI names music, cinema and television broadcasting, not media generally.

criteria.label: Excluded-activity revenue and interest income / total revenue
criteria.definition: Revenue from excluded activities, including interest income, must not exceed 5% cumulatively. A ratio exactly at 5% passes.
criteria.treatment_rules: Conservative Suhail proxy (D-172): MSCI adds interest income to the numerator and divides by revenue plus interest income. Suhail has no separate interest-income figure, so it adds the existing prohibited_income evidence (D-124) to excluded segment revenue and divides by total revenue. This may double-count and uses a smaller denominator, so it leans strict. Unknown prohibited income or unclassified segments make the result unknown.
criteria.edge_cases: Segments without revenue amounts (for example SIC-only classification) are unknown.
criteria.source_reference: MSCI Islamic Index Series Methodology (December 2025), §2.1 and footnote 4 (paraphrased); Suhail interest proxy

criteria.label: Total debt / total assets
criteria.definition: Total debt must not exceed 33.33% of total assets. A ratio exactly at 33.33% passes.
criteria.treatment_rules: Suhail interpretation (MSCI does not define total debt): all interest-bearing borrowings (short-term debt and commercial paper, current portion of long-term debt, long-term debt) plus finance lease liabilities; operating lease liabilities are excluded as operating, not financing, obligations under US GAAP. D-123 is unchanged for Al Rajhi. A finance-lease line absent from the filing is unknown, not zero.
criteria.edge_cases: Unknown or non-positive total assets blocks the calculation.
criteria.source_reference: MSCI Islamic Index Series Methodology (December 2025), §2.2 and §2.2.1 (paraphrased); Suhail total-debt interpretation
criteria.notes: Existing-constituent Financial Ratio Threshold 33.33%; entry buffer 30% and exit buffer 35% not applied.

criteria.label: Cash and interest-bearing securities / total assets
criteria.definition: Cash plus interest-bearing securities must not exceed 33.33% of total assets. A ratio exactly at 33.33% passes.
criteria.formula_text: (cash including restricted cash + short-term investments + long-term investments) / total_assets × 100 ≤ 33.33
criteria.numerator_definition: Cash, short-term and long-term investments (balance sheet)
criteria.treatment_rules: Conservative Suhail assumption: filings do not show which securities bear interest, so all short- and long-term investment balances are counted. Uses the validated balance-sheet evidence from the latest annual filing (D-155 context); unknown, never zero, when incomplete.
criteria.edge_cases: Financial institutions (SIC 6000–6299) have no prepared asset evidence and are unknown.
criteria.source_reference: MSCI Islamic Index Series Methodology (December 2025), §2.2 and §2.2.1 (paraphrased); Suhail conservative assumption
criteria.notes: Existing-constituent Financial Ratio Threshold 33.33%; entry buffer 30% and exit buffer 35% not applied.

criteria.label: Accounts receivable and cash / total assets
criteria.definition: Accounts receivable plus cash must not exceed 70% of total assets. A ratio exactly at 70% passes.
criteria.numerator_definition: Accounts receivable + cash and cash equivalents
criteria.treatment_rules: December 2025 existing-constituent Financial Ratio Threshold (70%); the October 2024 edition used 33.33%. Receivables use the SEC AccountsReceivableNetCurrent line; issuers using other receivable tags are unknown.
criteria.edge_cases: Missing receivables or cash is unknown; unknown total assets blocks the calculation.
criteria.source_reference: MSCI Islamic Index Series Methodology (December 2025), §2.2 and §2.2.1 (paraphrased)
criteria.notes: No exit buffer applies to this ratio in the source; entry buffer 46% not applied.

not_applied: Index membership, entry buffer and exit buffer (§2.2.1)
Three-consecutive-review rule and four-period average ratios (§2.2.1)
Index review timing and data dates (§3.1)
Country exceptions for Sharia-compliant debt and instruments (§2.2)
Treating insufficient information as non-compliant (§2); Suhail reports unknown
reviewer_questions: Meaning of 'directly active' in §2.1: primary activity (Suhail) or any direct involvement.
Interest income proxy: prohibited_income may double-count prohibited-activity revenue; denominator is revenue, not revenue plus interest income.
Total debt: Suhail includes finance leases and excludes operating leases; the dry run reports how many covered stocks would change if operating leases were included.
MSCI counts non-medical cannabis under tobacco; Suhail's tobacco category does not define cannabis.
Defense/weapons mapped to the existing conventional-weapons category.
conventional_media left off the list (confirmed by the founder on 8 November 2026, D-175).
Total assets from the latest annual 10-K (D-126), whereas MSCI uses the latest available report.
Receivables: only AccountsReceivableNetCurrent is mapped; other receivable tags are unknown.
